_meta.purpose: One Layer 1 table per cut — every part of the cut with size, share, growth, pace, the run of readings, and its share of the new money. Numbers are rendered here and shipped as strings; `sort` orders and is never drawn. Regenerated every gate; freshness-guarded with --check.
